name: Sgt (Ret.) Devon Harris
summary: Retired US Army logistics NCO, thirteen years of experience running supply operations and leading soldiers. Seeking warehouse operations management.

experience.title: NCOIC, Supply Support Activity
bullets: NCOIC of a 22-soldier SSA handling 9,000 line items; kept inventory accuracy above 98% through monthly cycle counts.
Supervised receiving, storage and issue of Class II, IX and VIII supplies for 3,400 soldiers.
Ran the unit safety program; zero lost-time accidents in 3 years.
Wrote and enforced the SOP for hazmat storage; passed every command inspection.

experience.title: Supply Sergeant (MOS 92A)
bullets: Managed $4.2M of unit property and signed for all hand receipts.
Planned 40+ convoy and rail movements for field exercises with no loss of equipment.
Trained 12 junior soldiers as automated logistical specialists.

experience.title: Automated Logistical Specialist (92A)
bullets: Processed requests and tracked shipments in the unit supply system.

education.degree: Warrior Leader Course and Advanced Leader Course
